name: dashboard-page
useFor: Use as a product's home screen. Pass `stats`, `usage`, `sites` and `runs`; replace the survey plate with the product's map in an app.
constraints: Round status dots (use the status pill)
source: brand/reference product UI boards (Figma 442:2) and the library's product parts: card, fit-score, status, progress, table, map
title: Dashboard page
description: The overview in the app shell: figures in DM Mono with the month's usage as a tick bar, the active search on a survey plate beside its shortlist with fit chips, and the latest runs with status pills.
